title: Albert Tan Research Lab
introduction: Explore published scholarship, experimental research software and teaching materials through their sources, demonstrations and stated limits.
scope_note: This is a curated public index. A source check records what was inspected at a date or revision; it does not certify legal accuracy, professional fitness or independent evaluation.

items.title: RegNav Evidence Ledger and ESG workbench
items.description: A local workflow for retained source passages, proposition-to-source evidence links and explicit human-review declarations.
items.limitation: Structural checks and source locations do not establish legal or factual truth. Candidate outputs and legal examples require human review.

verification.scope: Repository documentation and metadata inspected at the recorded revision.

citation.text: Tan, Sin Hon Albert. RegNav Evidence Ledger. Version 0.1.0; repository revision 130cf41b0d59e1f72a238b0cf3c145c6ca337265 (accessed 28 October 2026). https://github.com/Albertito-AI/policykit/tree/130cf41b0d59e1f72a238b0cf3c145c6ca337265
citation.provenance: Existing CITATION.cff supplies the software title, author, ORCID and version. No software DOI is recorded.

rights.summary: Rights reserved; no general reuse or open-source licence is supplied.

items.relationship_note: The repository identifies the Singapore/Thailand and China articles as research direction. Its teaching pack and Singapore case are separate materials; software checks do not validate the articles or complete human legal review.

items.title: RegNav Source Watch
items.description: A GitHub Action and local tool that compares committed evidence records and identifies claims affected by recorded source changes.
items.limitation: It checks declared Git inputs. It does not retrieve changing websites or decide whether a source proves a proposition.

verification.scope: Repository documentation and metadata inspected at the recorded revision.

citation.text: Albert Tan Sin Hon. RegNav Source Watch. Version 0.1.0; repository revision 2a6501fbbf535c58b11aeef16a8e8d0cc48148c0 (accessed 28 October 2026). https://github.com/Albertito-AI/regnav-source-watch/tree/2a6501fbbf535c58b11aeef16a8e8d0cc48148c0
citation.provenance: Citation assembled from the repository's recorded title, version and revision; author included only where explicitly identified as an author in its software metadata.

rights.summary: Apache-2.0 for this repository's original code, documentation and fictional fixtures. It grants no licence to policykit or third-party sources.

items.relationship_note: A separate implementation inspired by RegNav's evidence-record workflow. Its manifest is specific to this Action; the ledger JSON is not an interchange format for this release.

items.title: Symbolon
items.description: A local sandbox for specifying bounded machine work, checking recorded acceptance conditions and replaying evidence of a TEST-unit payment decision.
items.limitation: The examples use synthetic TEST units. The repository is not a deployed marketplace or a live payment service.

verification.scope: Repository documentation and metadata inspected at the recorded revision.

items.relationship_note: Piepowder's documented integration design proposes a separate interface with Symbolon. This catalog does not assert that the connector is implemented.

items.title: Piepowder
items.description: A local contract-evidence prototype that makes acceptance criteria explicit, preserves unresolved findings and simulates a review procedure.
items.limitation: All shipped cases are fictional. Completed numerical checks grant no legal determination, work permission or payment authority.

verification.scope: Repository documentation and metadata inspected at the recorded revision.

items.title: Tallystick
items.description: A research workbench that replays fictional sporting observations, corrections and count-market decisions, then exports evidence for a separate verifier.
items.limitation: Signatures and replay establish properties of the recorded example, not sporting truth, a live feed or financial settlement.

verification.scope: Repository documentation and metadata inspected at the recorded revision.

items.title: Converging Standards, Divergent Accountability: Sustainability Reporting in Singapore and Thailand
items.description: Comparative scholarship on how common reporting standards connect with evidence, supervision, liability and remedies in Singapore and Thailand.
items.venue: European Journal of Comparative Law and Governance

verification.scope: Institutional bibliographic metadata and abstract inspected. This catalog is not a new legal-source audit of the paper.

citation.text: Tan, T. S. H. A. (2026). Converging Standards, Divergent Accountability: Sustainability Reporting in Singapore and Thailand. European Journal of Comparative Law and Governance. Advance online publication. https://doi.org/10.1163/22134514-bja10122

items.relationship_note: RegNav identifies this paper as research direction, and its Singapore case cites the article's distinction between reporting duties and legal consequences. The two case propositions remain unreviewed.

items.title: When Does a Sustainability Report Count as Securities Disclosure in China? Channel Integration and Remedial Consequences
items.description: Scholarship distinguishing the disclosure channel used for an ESG statement from the conditions determining its legal consequences.

verification.scope: Institutional bibliographic metadata and abstract inspected. No DOI is supplied in that record.

items.title: Checking propositions against fictional sources
items.description: A suggested 55-minute exercise in locating evidence, distinguishing support from qualification, and repairing an overconfident draft. Includes a paper or spreadsheet route.
items.limitation: The sources and reviewer in the training fixture are fictional. Learning benefits and independent educational effectiveness have not been demonstrated.

verification.scope: Teaching guide and named material paths inspected at the recorded revision; no participant outcome is claimed.

rights.summary: RegNav's existing reserved-rights position applies. The pack is not an authorised companion to the coauthored forthcoming book ANSWERABLE.

items.relationship_note: An original teaching prototype in the RegNav repository using its fictional ledger and source packet. It is separate from the coauthored book and from the software usability pilot.

items.title: Singapore sustainability reporting: a narrow evidence case
items.description: A worked source-inspection case with two unreviewed propositions and primary-source references, showing how scope, versions and a separate disclosure duty must remain visible.
items.limitation: It determines no actual issuer's compliance, liability, standing or remedy. The catalog's inspection date does not update the legal source dates recorded in the case.

verification.scope: Case README, unreviewed status and linked paths inspected. This catalog does not independently recheck the underlying legal authorities.

rights.summary: RegNav's rights statement applies; SGX materials retain their own terms.

items.relationship_note: The case expressly uses the Singapore/Thailand article's analytical distinction. The software performs structural checks; it does not complete the independent legal review.

contributions.title: Trace one research proposition
contributions.description: Propose a narrow question with primary sources, exact pinpoints and an explicit review status, or document a reproducible difficulty. Agree applicable permissions before executable evaluation.

contributions.title: Reproduce a source-change example
contributions.description: Use synthetic fixtures to examine missing sources, removed evidence links or review metadata changed beside its source.

contributions.title: Reproduce the machine-work sandbox
contributions.description: Check the quickstart, acceptance profiles or selective evidence export using the existing development issues and synthetic inputs.

contributions.title: Clarify an unresolved finding
contributions.description: Discuss a fictional benchmark or unclear first-use step; agree contribution scope and permission under the reserved-rights terms before implementation.

contributions.title: Review a correction or completeness case
contributions.description: Write the expected synthetic outcome before changing an evaluator, or document an actual quickstart reproduction with the recorded software versions.

contribution_note: Credit follows actual contributions. Funded work requires agreed roles, deliverables, intellectual-property and payment terms; participation alone creates no payment entitlement.
